subject: MAP pocket proposal — short cushion & sprint to preserve close
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@novacare.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Nov 2024 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP pocket proposal — short cushion & sprint to preserve close

Samantha — thanks again for the sync this morning. Quick follow-up with a concrete proposal to keep the go-live in the current quarter while covering the evaluation slippage we saw on the last milestone.

Proposal (two-week pocket + focused sprint):
- Add a 10-working-day execution pocket to the MAP to absorb eval delays (no change to acceptance criteria).
- Run a compressed evaluation sprint targeting the top 3 integration scenarios only (team to deliver acceptance artifacts for these scenarios first).
- Canary deployment on a subset of users after the sprint to validate infra and latency at scale.

What we need from you to proceed by Friday EOD:
1) Confirm you can accept the two-week cushion in the MAP (we'll mark as conditional on procurement sign-off).
2) Agree on the 3 prioritized scenarios (we suggested: API perf, data retention flows, ID token rotation).

I've attached an updated MAP spreadsheet (MAP-v2.xlsx) that shows the revised milestones and a short risk column. If we get agreement, Jordan will update the MPA and Naomi will start collecting the SOC2 artifacts procurement requested.

If the team needs a hard date instead of a cushion, we can propose a staggered acceptance (partial go-live for non-PHI endpoints). Want to avoid that unless procurement forces a timeline change.

Can you confirm by Friday? If not, tell us the blocker so we can escalate proactively.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment: MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Samantha Cho <samantha@novacare.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Nov 2024 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP pocket proposal — short cushion & sprint to preserve close

Marcus — thanks for the clear proposal. I support the idea of a short cushion in principle but have two immediate constraints to flag:

1) Procurement timeline: our vendor legal has a DocuSign review window that could add up to 7 business days unless we provide all SOC2/HIPAA artifacts up-front. Procurement is copied (procurement@novacare.io).
2) Exec visibility: the VP sponsor wants a written impact note that outlines what we are deferring vs. what is in scope for the compressed eval sprint.

I can provisionally accept the 10-working-day pocket if you can deliver: (a) a one-page impact note by Thursday, and (b) the SOC2 evidence bundle. We also need a simple fallback definition: if the canary fails, what is the rollback plan and who owns the customer-facing comms?

I'll review the attached MAP and send my prioritized scenarios by EOD tomorrow.

—Samantha
Samantha Cho
Head of Platform Operations, NovaCare
samantha@novacare.io

Quoted: 
> Attachment: MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Nov 2024 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP pocket proposal — short cushion & sprint to preserve close

Team — forwarding Samantha's reply. We need a quick internal risk-log and a short readiness packet to meet her asks. Key asks and proposed owners: 

- One-page impact note for VP sponsor (Marcus/Jordan) — include what is deferred and what is guaranteed in the compressed eval.
- SOC2 evidence bundle (Naomi) — need the specific artifact list ASAP so procurement doesn't delay DocuSign window.
- Procurement cadence & billing impact memo (Kimberly) — procurement needs a clear milestone map and any invoice timing changes.

Risk / escalation proposal for record: 
- Risk trigger: if acceptance slips more than 3 weeks beyond the revised MAP pocket end date, open escalation to Sales Ops + Legal and prepare a credit/milestone extension offer.
- Short-term mitigation: prioritize acceptance artifacts that unblock procurement (config docs, retention SLA, encryption notes).

I attached MAP-v2.xlsx and SOC2-evidence.pdf to the internal thread. Please add a row to the deal risk log with the above trigger and mitigation and update HubSpot (ID in links).

Samantha requires the one-page impact note by Thursday; Naomi, can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts you can deliver by Wednesday? Kimberly, can you draft the procurement memo and a proposed billing milestone shift by EOD tomorrow so we can share with procurement@novacare.io?

If anybody sees a hard blocker to these owners, call it out now — we'll escalate to Jordan and my manager if we need executive help to keep this quarter.

Marcus

- Deliverable list: SOC2 Type II report (redacted), encryption-at-rest whitepaper (internal), data retention matrix, access-control attestation. I have the redacted Type II and the access-control attestation ready to share; encryption doc is with infra and I can get a current draft by Wednesday.
- I uploaded the preliminary artifacts to the secure share and attached the SOC2-evidence.pdf for internal QA.
- I'll also add a row to the deal risk log: "Novacare — procurement delay risk; trigger: >3 weeks slip; mitigation: expedited SOC2 delivery + conditional credit."

Action notes: 
- Naomi: share artifacts with procurement@novacare.io and copy Samantha by EOD Monday.
- Kimberly: please prepare the procurement/billing memo and a single-slide exec impact note we can attach to the MAP packet.
- Marcus/Jordan: I can help draft the one-page impact note if you want a SOC2 callout.

I'll mark the HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765) with the risk row after I share artifacts. We should be able to meet Samantha's ask if we prioritize these deliverables.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
